newsitem.title: UK: Allianz starts as hold by Salomon Brothers.
newsitem.headline: Allianz starts as hold by Salomon Brothers.

text.p: Salomon Brothers on Friday initiated coverage of Europe's largest insurance group, Allianz AG Holding, with a hold recommendation and a target price of 2,850 marks per share.

"The company is financially strong and able to seek further opportunistic expansion of its franchise. The giant could be awakening, but we believe that the story is not yet sufficiently compelling to warrant a more positive stance on the shares," the broker said in a research note.
Allianz shares were trading at around 2,770 at midday, up 16 on Thursday's close.

Analyst Trevor May said reported pre-tax profit growth in 1996 should be strong as results from underperforming operations respond to strong remedial action. However, he said he expected no progress in DVFA earnings.
Salomon forecasts 1996 reported pretax profits of 3.65 billion marks for Allianz versus 3.04 billion last time and DVFA earnings of 1.94 billion versus 1.97 billion.
The broker said it welcomed Allianz's improved disclosure and greater awareness of shareholder issues, as shown by its setting of a target to achieve a 15 percent net of tax return on equity by 1998.
